sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 完整文字任务 + 随题分析属性表（待编制）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: 四面体空间桁架四节点六杆；底面A=(0,0,0)、B=(4,0,0)、C=(2,2√3,0)m，顶点D=(2,2√3/3,3)m。A约束XYZ平移，B约束YZ平移，C仅约束Z平移；D向下30kN，其余方向自由。材料EA按公共契约。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 空间杆连接与消除刚体运动约束
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 顶点X/Y/Z位移、六杆轴力、各支座反力向量。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 空间杆连接与消除刚体运动约束；指定位置/分量对照数值真值，输出文字与结构化结果保持符号、单位和工况一致。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 空间桁架及独立真值需验证；完整题面、参数/单位契约与真值待验证
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 四面体空间桁架；正三角形底面；顶点投影为形心；四节点六杆
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: A约束XYZ平移；B约束YZ平移；C约束Z平移；其余平移自由
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 单材料单面积；三维轴力杆
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 保留题定几何、材料截面、边界和荷载；采用一阶线弹性静力、自重关闭。按明示全局/局部轴、字段单位及工况/组合计算；不新增刚性楼板、未声明刚臂或规范默认组合；结果位置/分量与原题一致。 采用仅轴力杆件，交叉是否连接按端点表；不把铰接杆改为刚接梁。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 拟要求真实 OpenSees 求解，保存输入与原始结果的对应关系；解析式/独立矩阵解用于校核，不能替代规定引擎执行证据。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 拟保存（尚未生成）：OpenSees 版本、可运行模型/脚本、节点构件和荷载表、实际计算日志、原始结果与工况索引、平衡/独立解校核记录。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 三维 truss 自由度、分支座平移约束、稳定性和三向反力读取需验证。 当前无据认定接口不支持；需实际能力测试后确定，不将未验证能力记为模型失败。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 拟建立独立审定的 OpenSees 模型及同版本/同设置参考结果；独立三维杆系矩阵解，检查刚度秩、三向节点力平衡及空间合力矩。 参考值尚未生成。 所有题定输出均须覆盖，校核实现不复用被测转换链路。

turns.instruction:
Build the four-node, six-member tetrahedral space truss using the complete attached tables. In global XYZ coordinates with Z upward: A=(0,0,0), B=(4,0,0), C=(2,2√3,0), D=(2,2√3/3,3) m. Use members AB, BC, CA, AD, BD and CD; D projects to the centroid of the equilateral base. Restrain translations X,Y,Z at A, Y,Z at B, and only Z at C. All other translations are free. Apply 30 kN downward at D. Members are axial-only elastic bars capable of both tension and compression. Rotations are inactive truss bookkeeping degrees of freedom. Use OpenSees for first-order static analysis with self-weight off. For LC1 report D's ux, uy, uz, axial N for all six bars, and the full global reaction vector (Fx,Fy,Fz) at each of A, B and C, including zero components. Use m and kN, with tension positive. Check spatial stability and global equilibrium.

The property appendix completes each area A as a solid square with side sqrt(A), Iy=Iz=A²/12 and J=0.14083333333333334 A². These are explicit authored section properties. All elements remain axial-only trusses; bending and torsion constants are inactive and axial stiffness remains EA.

Use the complete attached input tables. Global XYZ is right handed with Z upward; any planar model uses the XZ plane. All nodes listed are connected physical joints. Member local x points from i to j. In 2D local y=global +Y and local z=x cross y. In 3D local y=normalize(reference cross x), local z=x cross y; reference vectors are explicit. N is positive in tension. Signed section N/T/M2/M3 equal minus the i-end resisting action at the start and plus the j-end action at the end; V2/V3 use plus i-end and minus j-end action. Report global nodal displacements and support reactions; rotations follow the right-hand rule. Distributed loads act per actual member length, including inclined members. Use first-order linear elasticity with self-weight, rigid floors, rigid offsets, P-delta and construction stages off. Use only the specified cases and combinations. Compute every request in output-requests.json, retaining its location, side, signed component, unit and case/combination. Interior forces must include applied-load terms. Execute OpenSees and retain version, runnable input, current-model hash, run ID, actual solver log and raw result/case mapping. Report the requested results in the response body as well as structured results; independently check equilibrium. No numerical answer or native execution evidence is supplied.
